concerns.text: The pipeline schedules training of three SDM algorithms (Random Forest with 500 trees, Bioclim, MaxEnt‑style surrogate) for 30 species, performs 5‑fold spatial block cross‑validation, runs a hierarchical bootstrap with 10 000 iterations per algorithm, and sweeps multiple probability thresholds. On the GitHub Actions free tier (2 CPU cores, ≤ 7 GB RAM, ≤ 6 h runtime) this workload is unlikely to complete within the allotted time or memory limits, violating the compute constraints of the project.
